commits.summary: Preregister the caller draw and its eligibility crosswalk
commits.body:
Join all 110 P/Q/R PRs by repository, PR and alternate revisions against prior numbered cases, public behavior development, generator registrations, frozen transfers, shared qualification and numbered handoffs. The 98 eligible cases include 44 R PRs on 30 projects. The two reserved entries use only the URL roster and worktree HEADs. Commit the seed, stratified no-replacement selection and scoring rules before any draw or producer measurement.

Rebuilt the identity inventory twice, checked the two reserved rows and the disclosed overlaps, and tested stratum sizes, order independence and ten distinct R repositories on a synthetic roster. The changed-test selector identified no existing tests for the four evaluator files.

commits.summary: Qualify a retained argument after public return (verification pending)
commits.body:
Numbered review and the old-API caller can retain a configured DecimalFormat and read its public flag after a normal numeric return. JDI binds the argument, its calling thread, the return and the actual getter. A separately constructed formatter or an earlier read loses qualification even if its value agrees. Existing return-only registrations keep their shape.

All 55 change-selected suites passed. The original Spring parent returned BigDecimal 1.5 and the pinned formatter false. The real JDK 17 tracer independently identified argument 2 and the subsequent getter on that object. Job 20261127-040057-qualify-retained-formatter-arguments-on exercises numbered scaffold and resume, two flag settings, both releases and eight planted histories.
